The '''Tarsarian stomper''' was a non-native [[predator]]y species kept in [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] zoos. A breeding population survived the [[Destruction of Taris]], and initially thrived in the post-bombardment environment. A mutated strain of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] infected the population, resulting in the [[Tarsarian devourer]]. This new predator soon out-competed its predecessor, driving the stompers extinct on Taris.<ref name="TOR" />
